title: My Mall Dream
content: Hey! So I’ve just come across this sub now and didn’t realise the Mall was a common dream location. Is it the same for everyone else that they don’t really know what mall this is and it’s a mix of other things? I’ve had two lucid dreams at this Mall. The Mall I dream of doesn’t sound exactly the same as others but it is a mall. It’s been a while since I’ve dreamt of it too but as I say there was 2 dreams I had and it even had a character in the dream that was the same and I even had memory of the first time I was there which had progressed from last time.. First time I dreamt of the Mall i remember travelling there via speedboat and I crossed waters and this weird marshland to get there. It also looked as if there was an airfield outside of it/ also connected to a school (I know so random) Anyway when I first had the dream I was part of some cooking course where I was doing food tech in some restaurant with a whole bunch of other people. I remember this mall was kinda like a college/education centre of some sort. Towards the end of the first dream there was this older man in a suit wandering around who was apparently a big deal in the dream. One of the dream characters told me to make a good impression around him as he can advance your career and I remember chit chatting with him (I think) Second dream I remembered I’d been there before but it was different. Doors were locked and I remembered short cuts to different areas that weren’t accessible anymore. Grassy outside bit had overgrown and doors were locked up. The food tech class I did didn’t seem to be functioning, or not for me at least. There was still a class but I was not welcome at all to join and the people in the class even asked me to leave which felt horrible. I remember walking around the mall afterwards remembering I had been there before and then I saw the same old man who was the guy who was meant to be a big deal. I went over to go speak to him but realised I had no idea what to say without sounding crazy but he looked at me really strange too. He was at the same part of the mall as well. I had to go up escalators to speak to him. Sorry I know this was a useless post but just wanted to get my experience out there even if it is a shockingly bad account of both times
